findings: formation.type: “disputed” is a valid classification, but here it obscures the supported formation. Set the type to “semantic” and retain that qualification in the formation text (X-cac3a27c07527708ace2, X-141ca99faf199ae7d45b, X-c7d119c8b2ea05ee545c).
